description: Response returned when an agent attempts to acquire a write lock.

acquired.description: True if the lock was successfully acquired.
acquired.title: Acquired

lock_token.description: Cryptographic / UUID lease token required to execute writes.
lock_token.title: Lock Token

holder_id.description: ID of the agent currently holding the lock if acquisition failed.
holder_id.title: Holder Id

expires_at.description: Expiration timestamp for the acquired lock lease.
expires_at.title: Expires At

error_message.description: Error detail if lock acquisition failed or timed out.
error_message.title: Error Message

title: LockAcquireResponse
